title: Azure Functions vs App Service
description: Choose between serverless functions and App Service for event-driven workloads.

data.text: You need to process image uploads from Blob Storage, resize them, and save thumbnails. The workload is event-driven, runs intermittently, and you want to pay only for execution time. Should you use Azure Functions or App Service?

Choose **Azure Functions** for event-driven, intermittent workloads. Use ** Consumption Plan** for cost-effective execution. Only use App Service if you need long-running processes or full runtime control.

data.title: Azure Function - Blob Trigger (C#)

data.text: **Azure Functions** are serverless: you only pay for execution time. For the image resizer, you pay only when a blob is uploaded. App Service would cost a fixed amount even when idle.
